name: Outstanding Report
report_script:
columns = [
    {"label": "Project", "fieldname": "project", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Project", "width": 150},
    {"label": "Customer", "fieldname": "customer", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Customer", "width": 80},
    {"label": "Sales Order", "fieldname": "sales_order", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Sales Order", "width": 120},
    {"label": "Sales Invoice", "fieldname": "sales_invoice", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Sales Invoice", "width": 120},
    {"label": "Order Date", "fieldname": "order_date", "fieldtype": "Date", "width": 100},
    {"label": "Contract Netto", "fieldname": "contract_netto", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 130},
    {"label": "Already Billed Netto", "fieldname": "already_billed_netto", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 150},
    {"label": "Unbilled Netto", "fieldname": "unbilled_netto", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 130},
    {"label": "Invoice Outstanding Netto", "fieldname": "invoice_outstanding_netto", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 170},
    {"label": "Total Expected Netto", "fieldname": "total_expected_netto", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 150},
    {"label": "Type", "fieldname": "type", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 140},
    {"label": "Status", "fieldname": "status", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 120},
]

sql = (
    'SELECT so.project AS project, so.customer AS customer, so.name AS sales_order,'
    ' "" AS sales_invoice, so.transaction_date AS order_date,'
    ' so.net_total AS contract_netto,'
    ' IFNULL((SELECT SUM(si_item.net_amount) FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` si_item'
    ' JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = si_item.parent'
    ' WHERE si_item.sales_order = so.name AND si.docstatus = 1), 0) AS already_billed_netto,'
    ' (so.net_total - IFNULL((SELECT SUM(si_item.net_amount) FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` si_item'
    ' JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = si_item.parent'
    ' WHERE si_item.sales_order = so.name AND si.docstatus = 1), 0)) AS unbilled_netto,'
    ' 0 AS invoice_outstanding_netto,'
    ' (so.net_total - IFNULL((SELECT SUM(si_item.net_amount) FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` si_item'
    ' JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = si_item.parent'
    ' WHERE si_item.sales_order = so.name AND si.docstatus = 1), 0)) AS total_expected_netto,'
    ' CASE WHEN IFNULL((SELECT SUM(si_item.net_amount) FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` si_item'
    ' JOIN `tabSales Invoice` si ON si.name = si_item.parent'
    ' WHERE si_item.sales_order = so.name AND si.docstatus = 1), 0) > 0'
    ' THEN "Partially Invoiced" ELSE "Not Yet Invoiced" END AS type,'
    ' so.status AS status'
    ' FROM `tabSales Order` so'
    ' WHERE so.docstatus = 1'
    ' AND so.status NOT IN ("Completed", "Cancelled", "Closed")'
    ' AND so.per_billed < 100'
    ' AND (so.project IS NOT NULL OR so.project IS NULL)'
    ' AND so.name NOT IN (SELECT document_name FROM `tabTag Link`'
    ' WHERE document_type = "Sales Order" AND tag = "Zombie")'
    ' UNION ALL'
    ' SELECT si.project AS project, si.customer AS customer,'
    ' IFNULL((SELECT si_item.sales_order FROM `tabSales Invoice Item` si_item'
    ' WHERE si_item.parent = si.name AND si_item.sales_order IS NOT NULL AND si_item.sales_order != ""'
    ' LIMIT 1), "") AS sales_order,'
    ' si.name AS sales_invoice, si.posting_date AS order_date,'
    ' 0 AS contract_netto,'
    ' (si.net_total - (si.outstanding_amount / 1.19)) AS already_billed_netto,'
    ' 0 AS unbilled_netto,'
    ' (si.outstanding_amount / 1.19) AS invoice_outstanding_netto,'
    ' (si.outstanding_amount / 1.19) AS total_expected_netto,'
    ' "Invoiced Not Paid" AS type, si.status AS status'
    ' FROM `tabSales Invoice` si'
    ' WHERE si.docstatus = 1'
    ' AND si.outstanding_amount > 0'
    ' AND si.name NOT IN (SELECT document_name FROM `tabTag Link`'
    ' WHERE document_type = "Sales Invoice" AND tag = "Zombie")'
    ' ORDER BY project, order_date'
    ' LIMIT 1000'
)

rows = frappe.db.sql(sql, as_dict=True)

data = [columns, rows, None, None, None, False]

name: Projekt Übersicht
report_script:
columns = [
	{"label": "View", "fieldname": "view", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 90},
	{"label": "Bezeichnung", "fieldname": "label", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 260},
	{"label": "Umsatz Netto", "fieldname": "umsatz", "fieldtype": "Currency", "width": 140},
	{"label": "Anteil %", "fieldname": "anteil", "fieldtype": "Percent", "width": 100},
	{"label": "Key", "fieldname": "key", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 160},
]

filters = filters or {}
von = filters.get("von")
bis = filters.get("bis")
status_filter = filters.get("status") or "Alle"
unternehmen_filter = filters.get("unternehmen") or "Alle"

# Welche Project.status-Werte als "abgeschlossen" gelten -- alles andere zaehlt
# als "offen" (fail-open: ein unbekannter/neuer Statuswert taucht lieber unter
# "offen" auf, als beim Filtern stillschweigend zu verschwinden). Bestaetigt
# per Skript A gegen Live (25.08.2026): Project.status hat nur drei reale
# Werte -- Completed (529), Open (62), Cancelled (1). Die "Gebucht"/"Offen"-
# Badges im Listenview sind `workflow_state` (eigenes Feld), nicht `status`.
ABGESCHLOSSEN_STATUS = ["Completed", "Cancelled"]

status_clause = ""
if status_filter == "Abgeschlossen":
	status_clause = " AND p.status IN %(abgeschlossen)s"
elif status_filter == "Offen":
	status_clause = " AND (p.status NOT IN %(abgeschlossen)s OR p.status IS NULL)"

unternehmen_clause = ""
if unternehmen_filter and unternehmen_filter != "Alle":
	unternehmen_clause = " AND p.company = %(unternehmen)s"

# Gallehrs eigene Unternehmen (GSR, GSS, ...) tauchen in Project.customer
# gelegentlich als "Kunde" auf (Intercompany-Leistung, oder ein Datenfehler --
# beides kommt vor, siehe Skript B Live 25.08.2026). Umsatz bleibt in Typ/
# Projekt/PM unveraendert (echtes Geld, echter Auftrag), aber im Kunde-View
# wird das klar markiert statt so auszusehen wie ein normaler externer Kunde.
rows_raw = frappe.db.sql(
	"SELECT so.net_total AS umsatz, "
	"IFNULL(p.project_type, 'Ohne Typ') AS typ, "
	"p.name AS proj_key, IFNULL(p.project_name, p.name) AS proj_label, "
	"p.customer AS kunde_key, "
	"CASE WHEN EXISTS ("
	"    SELECT 1 FROM `tabCompany` co WHERE co.name = p.customer OR co.name = c.customer_name"
	"  ) THEN CONCAT(IFNULL(c.customer_name, p.customer, 'Unbekannt'), ' (eigenes Unternehmen)')"
	"  ELSE IFNULL(c.customer_name, p.customer, 'Unbekannt')"
	"END AS kunde_label, "
	"JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.`_assign`, '$[0]')) AS pm_key, "
	"IFNULL(u.full_name, 'Kein PM zugewiesen') AS pm_label "
	"FROM `tabSales Order` so "
	"JOIN `tabProject` p ON p.name = so.project "
	"LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` c ON c.name = p.customer "
	"LEFT JOIN `tabUser` u ON u.name = JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(p.`_assign`, '$[0]')) "
	"WHERE so.docstatus = 1 "
	"AND so.transaction_date BETWEEN %(von)s AND %(bis)s "
	"AND so.name NOT IN ("
	"  SELECT document_name FROM `tabTag Link`"
	"  WHERE document_type = 'Sales Order' AND tag = 'Zombie'"
	") " + status_clause + unternehmen_clause,
	{"von": von, "bis": bis, "abgeschlossen": tuple(ABGESCHLOSSEN_STATUS), "unternehmen": unternehmen_filter},
	as_dict=True,
)


def aggregate(rows, key_field, label_field):
	buckets = {}
	for r in rows:
		key = r[key_field] or "-"
		label = r[label_field] or "-"
		if key not in buckets:
			buckets[key] = {"key": key, "label": label, "umsatz": 0.0}
		buckets[key]["umsatz"] = buckets[key]["umsatz"] + (r["umsatz"] or 0.0)
	return sorted(buckets.values(), key=lambda b: b["umsatz"], reverse=True)


gesamt = sum((r["umsatz"] or 0.0) for r in rows_raw)


def emit(view_name, bucket_list, gesamt_umsatz):
	out = []
	for b in bucket_list:
		anteil = (b["umsatz"] / gesamt_umsatz * 100.0) if gesamt_umsatz else 0.0
		out.append({
			"view": view_name,
			"label": b["label"],
			"umsatz": b["umsatz"],
			"anteil": anteil,
			"key": b["key"],
		})
	# Summenzeile je View -- eigener view-Wert (view_name + "_gesamt"), damit
	# das Dashboard (das nur "typ"/"projekt"/"kunde"/"pm" kennt) sie automatisch
	# ignoriert, waehrend sie im vollen Report direkt nach den echten Zeilen
	# dieser View als 100%-Kontrolle sichtbar bleibt.
	out.append({
		"view": view_name + "_gesamt",
		"label": "— Gesamt —",
		"umsatz": gesamt_umsatz,
		"anteil": 100.0 if gesamt_umsatz else 0.0,
		"key": "",
	})
	return out

data_rows = []
data_rows += emit("typ", aggregate(rows_raw, "typ", "typ"), gesamt)
data_rows += emit("projekt", aggregate(rows_raw, "proj_key", "proj_label"), gesamt)
data_rows += emit("kunde", aggregate(rows_raw, "kunde_key", "kunde_label"), gesamt)
data_rows += emit("pm", aggregate(rows_raw, "pm_key", "pm_label"), gesamt)

data = [columns, data_rows, None, None, None, False]
